name: opsgenie
description: Opsgenie integration — list, inspect, acknowledge, and close alerts, create new alerts that page on-call responders, and see who is on call for a schedule. Talks to the Opsgenie Alert API v2.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Opsgenie alerts, on-call schedules, and incident response

fields.label: Region
fields.helpText: Opsgenie account region: us (default) or eu

tools.name: opsgenie.list_alerts
tools.description: List alerts, optionally filtered with an Opsgenie search query.

query.description: Opsgenie search query, e.g. 'status: open AND priority: P1'

tools.name: opsgenie.get_alert
tools.description: Get a single alert by its id, tiny id, or alias.

alertId.description: Alert id (or tiny id / alias via identifierType)

tools.name: opsgenie.acknowledge_alert
tools.description: Acknowledge an alert so responders know it is being handled.

note.description: Optional note added to the alert

tools.name: opsgenie.close_alert
tools.description: Close an alert, marking the underlying issue as resolved.

note.description: Optional note added to the alert

tools.name: opsgenie.create_alert
tools.description: Create a new alert. This can page on-call responders — use with care.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the alert

tools.name: opsgenie.who_is_on_call
tools.description: Get the current on-call participants for a schedule.
